title: Refund policy
paragraphs: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of delivery. The original payment method is credited after the returned item passes inspection.
Start a return from the order details page. A prepaid shipping label is available for eligible orders, and the refund normally appears within five business days after inspection.

title: Check refund status
paragraphs: The order details page shows whether a return was requested, received, inspected, or refunded.
If a refund is marked complete but the credit is missing, contact the card issuer with the refund reference number.

title: Damaged item on arrival
paragraphs: Report a broken or defective item within seven days of delivery and include clear photos of the product and packaging.
After review, support can arrange a replacement or a refund without charging return shipping.

title: Exchange an item for another size
paragraphs: An unused clothing item can be exchanged for another size within 30 days when the requested size is in stock.
Choose Exchange on the order details page and print the supplied label. The replacement ships after the original item is received.

title: Cancel an order before shipment
paragraphs: An order can be cancelled from its details page until the warehouse begins packing it.
Once shipment starts, use the return process after delivery. A cancellation confirmation is sent by email.

title: Change a delivery address
paragraphs: Edit the delivery address on the order details page before the warehouse starts packing.
After dispatch, the carrier may offer a delivery redirect. Address changes are unavailable for some international orders.

title: Track a shipment
paragraphs: A tracking number appears in the order details page once the parcel leaves the warehouse.
Carrier scans may take several hours to appear. Use the tracking link in the dispatch email for the latest delivery estimate.

title: Late delivery
paragraphs: Weather, customs checks, or carrier congestion can delay a parcel beyond the estimated delivery date.
If tracking has not changed for five business days, contact support with the order number so the team can open a carrier investigation.

title: Download an invoice
paragraphs: Download a PDF invoice from the Billing section of an order after payment has settled.
The invoice includes the order date, items, tax, and payment total. Business customers can update company details before downloading it.

title: Payment did not go through
paragraphs: A bank may decline a card charge because of insufficient funds, an expired card, or an authentication check.
Verify the card details and try again. If the bank still declines the transaction, contact the bank or choose another payment method.

title: Update a saved payment method
paragraphs: Add or remove a saved card from the Payment methods section of account settings.
Changing a saved card affects future purchases only. Completed orders continue to show their original payment method.

title: Reset an account password
paragraphs: Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page to request a one-time reset email.
The reset link expires after 30 minutes. If no email arrives, check the spam folder and confirm the account address.
